description: This file defines a Go plugin for the gogo/protobuf code generator, specifically implementing a 'union' extension that generates methods for union-like message handling, including GetValue and SetValue methods, for protobuf messages marked with the 'onlyone' extension.

classes.name: union
classes.description: A plugin class that generates GetValue and SetValue methods for protobuf messages with the 'onlyone' extension.
